description: Accordion built on native details/summary with exclusive mode and transitions

attributes.name: single
attributes.description: Only allow one panel open at a time

attributes.name: flush
attributes.description: Remove inline padding on summaries and panels so content aligns with surrounding text

structure.description: One per accordion panel — native disclosure element

events.name: accordion-wc:toggle
events.description: Fired when a panel opens or closes

events.name: accordion-wc:panels-changed
events.description: Fired after the panels property rebuilds the accordion

methods.name: open(index)
methods.description: Open the panel at index (out-of-range indexes are ignored)

methods.name: openAll()
methods.description: Open every panel (no-op in single mode)

properties.name: panels
properties.description: Get the panel set as data, or assign one to rebuild the accordion
